title: The Euro edges lower as Frankfurt's hike takes effect the day Washington votes
summary: EUR/USD closed Tuesday near 1.1540, down 0.1%. It fell on the day the European Central Bank (ECB) raised its deposit rate to 2.50% and in each of the three sessions since.

title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Rebounds above 207.00 as oversold risk eases
summary: The GBP/JPY edges higher by about 0.29% on Tuesday, even as risk appetite has shifted to the sour side due to geopolitical developments that are driving global bond yields higher amid inflation fears. At the time of writing, the cross-pair trades at 209.02 after bouncing off daily lows of 208.25.

title: Why AI researchers warn humanity could face extinction
summary: Could artificial intelligence pose an existential threat to humanity? Some leading researchers are warning against an unregulated race toward AI superintelligence.
